name: saucedemo-playwright-allure
description: SauceDemo automation using Playwright, POM, and Allure reports

scripts.test:q1: npx playwright test --grep @q1 && npm run allure:generate
scripts.test:q2: npx playwright test --grep @q2 && npm run allure:generate
scripts.test:q3: npx playwright test --grep @q3 && npm run allure:generate
scripts.test:all: npx playwright test --grep "@q1|@q2|@q3" && npm run allure:generate
